title: Craftable heavy core (mace)
body:
This Datapack add craft heavy core (mace) for minecraft in survival 1.21.7-1.21.8
For craft you need 1 iron block and 8 ominous trial key (default chance for heavy core is 7.5%, you you can save 6 keys with this datapack)
